intent: Close the safely remediable npm and Rust dependency alerts without falsifying the desktop shell's compiler support: retain the patched dashboard and Cargo lock closures, raise the desktop shell's declared MSRV to the first compiler accepted by the patched serde_with line, and add an exact-MSRV macOS CI lane that runs the locked desktop-shell check and test commands.

negative_controls.name: lowering-desktop-msrv-is-caught
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,subprocess,sys; p=pathlib.Path('desktop-shell/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'); t=p.read_text(); p.write_text(t.replace('rust-version = \"1.88\"','rust-version = \"1.77\"')); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_polyglot_ci_contract.py::test_desktop_shell_ci_pin_matches_manifest_msrv'],check=False); p.write_text(t); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode != 0 else 1)"

commit.message: fix(security): align patched desktop dependencies with Rust 1.88

interface_mismatches: desktop-shell/src-tauri/Cargo.toml advertised Rust 1.77 while the patched Cargo.lock selected serde_with 3.21.0 and time 0.3.55, both of which require Rust 1.88.
The required tests workflow had no desktop-shell Rust lane, so a lockfile-only update could pass repository CI without compiling on the declared minimum compiler.

dashboard/package-lock.json and desktop-shell/src-tauri/Cargo.lock had no Session Entry packet even though the dashboard lockfile is a Mike hot path and both files belong to the same bounded dependency-security change.
honest_blockers: CEREMONY ORDER WAS VIOLATED AND THIS RECEIPT SAYS SO: the two lockfile updates were authored before this packet existed. This packet is a retrospective scope binding for those exact files; the MSRV and CI-alignment repair is packet-declared before editing.

Preserving Rust 1.77 is not compatible with closing both Rust advisories: serde_with 3.21.0 is the first release patched for GHSA-7gcf-g7xr-8hxj and requires Rust 1.88; time 0.3.47 is the first release patched for RUSTSEC-2026-0009 and requires Rust 1.83. The shared safe compiler floor is therefore 1.88.

Two medium alerts are outside this packet and remain tracked in issue #1448: the frozen LangGraph SQLite oracle needs a receipt-preserving migration, and Tauri's Linux GTK 0.18 graph cannot consume patched glib 0.20 without an upstream-compatible transition.
Exact Rust 1.88.0 cargo check --locked and cargo test --locked passed locally on macOS before packet closeout. A live CI result on the new lane is not claimed until GitHub executes the pushed head.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet's commits together. That restores the prior lockfiles and Rust 1.77 declaration, which also restores the known dependency advisories; do not roll back only Cargo.toml because that would recreate an impossible compiler claim against the patched lock closure.
